data.name: Open Carbon Protocol
data.description: Open Carbon Protocol (OCP) is a collaborative carbon crediting registry and methodology platform operated by oneshot.earth, a Delaware-incorporated company. It uses a peer-review-style process with external expert panels to develop and approve methodologies and validate projects across the voluntary carbon market, covering both emission reductions and removals.
